prompts.prompt:
Transform the supplied user's rough sketch into an ORIGINAL production-ready transparent game sprite atlas for a Terraria-style 2D raid boss called Ghost Samurai. Reference image role: user concept drawing only; retain horned oni skull, exposed skeletal ribs, ghostly blue-white coloring, two curved katanas (the arm asset will be mirrored in-game). Ignore all writing in reference.
Use case: stylized-concept. Output ONE 1024x1024 PNG with genuine transparent alpha background, no checkerboard painted into pixels, no text, no labels, no borders.
EXACT ATLAS LAYOUT: two non-overlapping rectangular columns, each 512x1024 pixels.
LEFT COLUMN x0..511: ONE front-facing floating boss BODY ONLY, without arms, without hands and without any weapons. Center it at x256. Horned menacing skeletal oni face with long swept upward horns, luminous cyan eyes in very dark sockets, sharp teeth and fangs, large angular jaw; clearly exposed ribcage and spine, modest dark navy battered samurai shoulder plates and waist armor, no helmet covering horns or face; torn spectral ribbons and a tapering wispy blue ghost tail instead of legs. Top horn tips near y50, skull around y220, shoulders around y390, ribs around y510, waist y710, tail ends near y980. Keep entire silhouette at least 20px away from column boundaries. Clean navy/near-black outline, cold ivory bones with blue shaded planes, restrained cyan flame rim, readable solid shaded masses, NOT line art. Spine and ribcage must remain visible.
RIGHT COLUMN x512..1023: ONE detached RIGHT skeletal ARM with HAND HOLDING ONE long curved KATANA, isolated as a single cutout assembly; NO additional body or head. Coordinates relative to this right column: small shoulder bone joint centered at (85,650), upper arm extends down-right to an elbow at about (170,790), forearm rises toward hand centered at (295,645). Fingers visibly wrap a dark blue hilt; round/small square iron guard above fist, long icy silver-blue curved katana blade rises toward tip at (410,100). Blade curves elegantly, not straight laser. Shoulder pivot and bent arm are complete. Do not connect to left column. Keep at least 20px transparent gutter at every column edge.
Style: richly shaded crisp pixel-art game sprite with intentional stepped edges and clusters, ominous majestic undead samurai, limited palette ~navy, muted steel blue, cold ivory, electric pale cyan accents. High readability at in-game scale around 170px torso with extended horns/tail and 200px swords. No huge bloom, no external aura cloud, no attack trails or beams, no scenery. Transparent holes between ribs and around all components. No third-party franchise characters. This is actual runtime art, not a concept sheet mockup.
